annotations.title: Human Design transits for a date

description: The gates and lines the Sun, Moon, nodes and planets activate at a moment (now by default, or a given date and time in UTC). With a person's birth data it also lists the channels the transits complete with that person's own gates, the usual way to read a day's influence, apart from channels the transits form on their own.

date.description: Day to look at as YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

language.description: Language of the titles and summaries: en (default), nl (Dutch) or de (German).

birth_date.description: The person's date of birth as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "1988-03-21".

birth_place.description: Where The person's was born, as "City", "City, Country" or "City, Region, Country", e.g. "Utrecht, Netherlands", "Springfield, Illinois, USA". Used only to find the time zone.

birth_time.description: The person's local clock time of birth, 24-hour HH:MM, e.g. "14:05". Leave out when unknown: noon is used and time_uncertainty_minutes defaults to 720.

name.description: A first name or label, only to tell the two people apart in the answer.

time_uncertainty_minutes.description: How far off the birth time may be, in minutes either way (e.g. 30 for "around half past two"). The result then says which parts of the chart could change.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birthplace, e.g. "Europe/Berlin". Needed only when the place is not found; overrides the place's zone when given.

time_utc.description: Time of day in UTC as HH:MM (default now when date is today, else 12:00).
